summary: Ran a fresh isolated headless Chrome context at the assigned #downloads state. No form, add-to-cart, order, payment or email action was submitted. Hash initialization selected only downloads; pointer activation of technical and keyboard Enter activation of downloads correctly updated aria-selected, the active panel and URL hash. The inquiry dialog opened and closed with matching aria-hidden state, and no page/console errors were observed. Download activation cannot be accepted because the genuine source file/destination and exact icon export are not available.
